description: List an Instagram channel's recent posts (newest first) with id, caption, type, thumbnail, permalink, date and comment count. Use the ids in a comment trigger's mediaId (a list) to limit a flow to specific posts. Only for accounts connected with Instagram login (authMethod official).

after.description: nextCursor from a previous call, for older posts

id.description: UUID of the Instagram social channel

name: neuron_list_instagram_posts
title: List Instagram Posts
